name: Nullharbor
notes: Fold clip (Anchorage 01 / local traffic): the leftover artifact is pixel crawl on hard un-antialiased edges, not classic tearing. Station spokes and hull strokes were 1 CSS-px in world space; at Fold backing×zoom that is a sub-pixel stair-step that recrawls every frame (and worse when the hull or wheel rotates).
World strokes now keep a 1.4 device-pixel hairline (round joins) for ships and stations. The chase camera still snaps to backing pixels. Distant stars stay on the unsapped interpolated camera.
#space stays a transparent 2D canvas (2.16.2 Fold white-flash) but is no longer desynchronized, so Chrome cannot front-buffer under the HUD.
Sky bake-before-fill, backing slack, and launch/jump art warmup from 2.16.2 are unchanged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.3. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
